maximum_depth_rule: The current-plan digital-book page contains one compound line covering several industries, population, income, lodging, enterprise, and estimate values. The line remains one raw maximum-depth record until an official structured table can be reviewed.
page_boundary: Evidence page 24 is derived transparently from the official digital-book URL segment index24.html; the original reviewed source location remains HTML row 3.
history_boundary: The 2026-2029 plan is the current source. Targets, results, and self-evaluations from the plan ending in fiscal 2025 are not inherited automatically, and the first annual evaluation is not yet published.
non_goals: Do not split the compound digital-book line into inferred independent indicators.
Do not promote mixed estimates or plan values to a separately reviewed annual actual.
Do not inherit prior-plan targets or results into the current plan.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
